thread:
Hosting AI Apps in Saudi Arabia: The In-Kingdom Data-Flow Playbook

Quick thread 🧵
You can host almost all of an AI app in-Kingdom on Google Cloud's Dammam region (me-central2): the app, the managed database, uploaded files, and the embeddings.
The piece that leaves is the prompt you send a hosted model API.
Decide per data type what stays, minimize what you send across the border, and self-host an open model only when the data truly cannot leave.
